body:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1: production inference latency spike (high tail, 95th > 8s) for region eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Alert: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alerts/INC-4300123456 · warroom: https://meet.redwood.ai/warroom/INC-4300123456
kevin (oncall): Ack, joining warroom now :hand: I'm oncall for this window. Who's owning mitigation?
dmitri (eng-runtime): Joining. I see repeated autoscaler errors around 4300123100: "scale failed - quota exceeded" on dedicated pool. Quick snippet from autoscaler logs:
```
E0331 12:01:40 scale.go:221] scale failed: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = GPU quota exceeded
... retries 4/5
```
maria (product): Customer impact summary so far: multiple SaaS customers intermittently getting 429s and large tail latencies (5-12s) for generation endpoints. No data exfiltration. Prioritize high-traffic orgs in EU first. I'll start a status page draft and pull customer list.
kevin (oncall): Owner assignment: dmitri -> mitigation lead. maria -> customer comms and status page. alice -> support triage & account pings. I'll coordinate handoff if needed.
dmitri (eng-runtime): Mitigation plan (short):
1) Increase dedicated pool quota temporarily for prod (requesting quick bump via cloud console).
2) Activate fallback routing to v1-small for non-critical routes to relieve GPU pressure.
3) If autoscaler process still failing, restart autoscaler with zero-downtime restart steps.
Commands I'll run in warroom:
```
# bump pool cap (console), then
kubectl -n inference patch cm autoscaler-config --patch '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":120}}'
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/autoscaler
```
maria (product): Status page plan: short summary + ETA + impact list + what we're doing + next update in 15m. Draft link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4300123456/draft - please review.
statusbot: Draft published to status.redwood.ai/incidents/4300123456 (internal draft). Set visibility to public when we confirm mitigations.
alice (support): I'll prepare targeted emails for the top 8 impacted accounts, cc'ing their account reps. Will post a canned message here for review in 10m.
kevin (oncall): Paging confirmations: I paged dmitri @dmitri, got ack. If anyone else needs to be paged (infra or cloud quotas), call them now. We plan a handoff if this goes beyond the oncall window (30m).
dmitri (eng-runtime): Bumped maxReplicas, watching cluster metrics now. If tail latency improves after routing fallback, we'll keep tuning. I'll update in 3m with results.
maria (product): Draft customer line: "We're investigating an elevated latency affecting inference in EU/US regions; services are degraded for some customers. We're applying capacity and routing mitigations; next update in 15 minutes." Approve?
kevin (oncall): Approved. Maria, post when dmitri confirms mitigation worked. I'll prep follow-up internal summary for SOC and accounts.
statusbot: Next status update scheduled at 4300123516 (T+5m).
dmitri (eng-runtime): Initial metrics look promising: 95th latency down from ~9s to ~3.2s after routing to v1-small and bumping pool cap. Continuing to monitor, will escalate to infra if quota errors persist.
alice (support): Canned customer note ready, posting here for final sign-off.
kevin (oncall): Good first pass. Keep warroom active, update status page to public if we see sustained improvement for 10min. Handoff plan: if issue persists beyond 30m, I'll page infra lead @sophia and transfer incident owner.
